## Problem and change

What user or agent behavior does this fix? What stays out of scope?

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Include unverified behavior or tooling limits.

## Sources and license

For imported or adapted material, link the source and state its license and modifications.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Local links, recipe counts, and related guidance remain consistent.
- [ ] Accessibility, reduced motion, and cleanup are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, local paths, lab apps, or generated output are included.
- [ ] Third-party rights and required notices are preserved.
